## Part 1

using a hashtable https://r-lib.github.io/fastmap/

```{r}
coord2str <- function(coord) paste(coord, collapse = '|')
str2coord <- function(str) str_split_1(str, fixed('|')) |> as.numeric()

head_travel <- function(h, instruc, prev) {
  move <- str_extract(instruc, "^[A-Z]")
  val <- str_extract(instruc, "\\d+$") |> as.integer()
  new <- switch(
    move,
    'U' = c(0, val),
    'L' = c(-val, 0),
    'R' = c(val, 0),
    'D' = c(0, -val),
    stop("Unknown input")
  )
  for (i in prev[1]:new[1]) {
    for (j in prev[2]:new[2]) {
      new <- coord2str(c(i, j))
      h$set(new, h$get(new) + 1)
    }
  }
  
  message(paste("move ", move, "new ", new, "h ", h$get(new)))
  str2coord(new)
}
```

```{r}
head <- fastmap(missing_default = 0L)

input <- read_lines(I("R 4
U 4
L 3
D 1
R 4
D 1
L 5
R 2"))


#input <- read_lines("input/09")

start <- c(0, 0)

head$set(coord2str(start), 1)

for (m in input) {
  start <- head_travel(head, m, start)
}
```


```{r}
#| eval: false
for (k in head$keys()) {
  message("key: ", k, ": ", head$get(k))
}
```
